# Game Idea: Asteroid Dodge

Control a spaceship using the arrow keys on an HTML canvas. Asteroids spawn randomly from the edges and move across the screen. The goal is to survive as long as possible by dodging collisions. **Lose condition:** the game ends when the spaceship collides with an asteroid. Score increases with time survived.

1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   const width = canvas.width;
12:   const height = canvas.height;
13: 
14:   // Pre‑generate starfield
15:   const stars = Array.from({length: 100}, () => ({
16:     x: Math.random() * width,
17:     y: Math.random() * height,
18:     radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
19:   }));
20: 
21:   // Audio context and helper
22:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
23:   function playBeep(freq, duration) {
24:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
25:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
26:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
27:     osc.type = 'square';
28:     osc.connect(gain);
29:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
30:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
31:     osc.start();
32:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
33:   }
34: 
35:   // Spaceship
36:   const ship = {
37:     w: 30,
38:     h: 20,
39:     x: width / 2 - 15,
40:     y: height - 40,
41:     speed: 4,
42:     color: '#0f0',
43:   };
44: 
45:   // Input handling
46:   const keys = {};
47:   let audioStarted = false;
48:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; if (!audioStarted) { audioCtx.resume(); audioStarted = true; } });
49:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
50: 
51:   // Asteroids
52:   const asteroids = [];
53:   const asteroidInterval = 1500; // ms
54:   const maxSpeed = 2.5;
55: 
56:   function spawnAsteroid() {
57:     // Choose random edge
58:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4); // 0: top, 1: right, 2: bottom, 3:left
59:     let x, y, vx, vy;
60:     const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 10;
61:     switch (edge) {
62:       case 0:
63:         x = Math.random() * width;
64:         y = -radius;
65:         vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * maxSpeed;
66:         vy = Math.random() * maxSpeed + 0.5;
67:         break;
68:       case 1:
69:         x = width + radius;
70:         y = Math.random() * height;
71:         vx = -Math.random() * maxSpeed - 0.5;
72:         vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * maxSpeed;
73:         break;
74:       case 2:
75:         x = Math.random() * width;
76:         y = height + radius;
77:         vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * maxSpeed;
78:         vy = -Math.random() * maxSpeed - 0.5;
79:         break;
80:       case 3:
81:         x = -radius;
82:         y = Math.random() * height;
83:         vx = Math.random() * maxSpeed + 0.5;
84:         vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * maxSpeed;
85:         break;
86:     }
87:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, radius, color: '#f44' });
88:   }
89: 
90:   const spawnTimer = setInterval(spawnAsteroid, asteroidInterval);
91: 
92:   let startTime = performance.now();
93:   let gameOver = false;
94: 
95:   function update(dt) {
96:     // Move ship
97:     let moved = false;
98:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] && ship.x > 0) { ship.x -= ship.speed; moved = true; }
99:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] && ship.x + ship.w < width) { ship.x += ship.speed; moved = true; }
100:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && ship.y > 0) { ship.y -= ship.speed; moved = true; }
101:     if (keys['ArrowDown'] && ship.y + ship.h < height) { ship.y += ship.speed; moved = true; }
102:     if (moved) playBeep(150, 0.05);
103: 
104:     // Move asteroids
105:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
106:       const a = asteroids[i];
107:       a.x += a.vx;
108:       a.y += a.vy;
109:       // Remove off‑screen asteroids
110:       if (a.x < -a.radius * 2 || a.x > width + a.radius * 2 || a.y < -a.radius * 2 || a.y > height + a.radius * 2) {
111:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
112:       }
113:     }
114: 
115:     // Collision detection (circle‑rect)
116:     for (const a of asteroids) {
117:       const distX = Math.abs(a.x - (ship.x + ship.w / 2));
118:       const distY = Math.abs(a.y - (ship.y + ship.h / 2));
119:       if (distX > (ship.w / 2 + a.radius) || distY > (ship.h / 2 + a.radius)) continue;
120:       if (distX <= ship.w / 2 || distY <= ship.h / 2) { gameOver = true; playBeep(300, 0.3); break; }
121:       const dx = distX - ship.w / 2;
122:       const dy = distY - ship.h / 2;
123:       if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= a.radius * a.radius) { gameOver = true; playBeep(300, 0.3); break; }
124:     }
125:   }
126: 
127: function draw() {
128:     // Space background
129:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
130:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
131:     // Stars
132:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
133:     for (const s of stars) {
134:       ctx.beginPath();
135:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
136:       ctx.fill();
137:     }
138:     // Ship - already drawn as triangle in draw section below
139:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
140:     ctx.beginPath();
141:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
142:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
143:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
144:     ctx.closePath();
145:     ctx.fill();
146:     // Asteroids with radial gradient
147:     for (const a of asteroids) {
148:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, 0, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
149:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#fff');
150:       grad.addColorStop(1, a.color);
151:       ctx.beginPath();
152:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
153:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
154:       ctx.fill();
155:     }
156:     // Score
157:     const elapsed = ((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
158:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
159:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
160:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${elapsed}s`, 10, 20);
161:     if (gameOver) {
162:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
163:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
164:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
165:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
166:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
167:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
168:     }
169:   }
170:     // Score
171:     const elapsed = ((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
172:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
173:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
174:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${elapsed}s`, 10, 20);
175:     if (gameOver) {
176:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
177:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
178:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
179:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
180:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
181:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
182:     }
183:   }
184: 
185:   let lastTime = performance.now();
186:   function loop() {
187:     const now = performance.now();
188:     const dt = now - lastTime;
189:     lastTime = now;
190:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
191:     draw();
192:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
193:     else clearInterval(spawnTimer);
194:   }
195: 
196:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
197: });

(End of file - total 197 lines)
</content>
